description: dgx-spark-qwen38 is an open-source installer that turns an NVIDIA DGX Spark, or any GB10 machine (ASUS, Dell, HP, Lenovo, MSI, GIGABYTE, Acer), into a private AI server in one command: measured model lanes, OpenAI and Anthropic APIs, and a local cockpit.
summary: Fastest measured Qwen3.8-27B config for DGX Spark (GB10): SGLang + NVFP4 + DFlash2, deterministic boots, 50 tok/s greedy median, 148 tok/s at 8 streams, 258 at 32. One command, everything pinned, lossless.
